init_torch_distributed: init torch distributed process group with nccl backend and automatic port selection for multi-GPU training
init_process_group: init a fairseq2 Gang from the default process group with submitit environment support and timeout
get_fsdp_wrap_policy: get an FSDP wrap policy for a transformer model at layer, stack, or model granularity
get_fsdp_memory_policy: get an FSDP memory policy by name such as standard, low, or very_low
get_global_rank: get the global rank of the current process from torch.distributed, torchrun, or SLURM env vars
